purpose: Single authority for which world, declared 2-D map and profile the commissioning work uses. Verify with verify_operating_lock.py; NEVER rewrite this file in the same action as the thing it protects - that certifies a change instead of detecting it.

superseded_capture_world.note: The world the v3 master capture and the v4 edge extension were captured against. Every existing image and every commissioned q/R field belongs to THIS hash.

profile.map_semantics: The map is ONE statement: the 14 traversable lanes are the drivable region and their complement is non-drivable. There are no non_driveable boxes, because a separate subtractive layer contradicted the lanes - 19.66 m2 was declared both drivable and not, while protecting 0 m2 of real obstacle.
profile.traversable_derivation: maximal-rectangle cover of the region clearing all 56 collision prisms by >= 0.275 m, the chassis half-width. The region says where the BODY MAY BE, not where it may spin: the planner checks its own footprint against it. Produced by redraw_traversable_map.py on 2026-09-18.

collision_parse_contract.note: include_names is REQUIRED. bin_office, forklift_parked, pallet_jack and the two loose pallets are top-level <include> models, NOT inside warehouse_shell or warehouse_v2_occluders. Omitting include_names yields 44 prisms instead of 56 and silently drops the bin, forklift, pallet jack and both loose pallets.

freeze_status.explanation: The frozen manifest's expected world hash (4b773b98...) is what make_world.py regenerates today. The world FILE on disk (1c7e913d...) was edited after the freeze was taken and is 13939 bytes larger. The diff is confined to the Cm barrel stacks: 21 extra drum links and a fourth stack obs_Cm_p3. No <include>, no model, no camera pose and no declared region differs.
freeze_status.authority: The WORLD FILE ON DISK is authoritative for this thesis, because both the v3 master capture and the v4 edge extension record its hash as the world they captured against. The generator and the freeze manifest are behind it.
freeze_status.refreeze_not_performed: world_freeze.py --refreeze is only legitimate before any image of a world has been captured. 22130 views already exist against this world, so refreezing now would misrepresent the evidence chain.

open_defect.poses_intersecting_include_geometry: Re-tested with the correct 56-prism scene: 90 of 4426 poses place the 0.80x0.55 m body inside an include object (v3 58, extension 32), touching 450 of 22130 index rows across 17 positions. Objects: bin_office, forklift_parked, pallet_loose_2, pallet_jack, pallet_loose_1. UNRESOLVED - v3 predates the extension, so this is not introduced by the v4 work.

history.change: Traversable map replaced: the previous hand-drawn 14-lane map overlapped bin_office, forklift_parked and pallet_jack because it was drawn without the top-level <include> objects in view. A 21-lane variant that appeared in the profile on 2026-09-18 was discarded: its 357 m2 was double-counting across 17 overlapping lane pairs, true union area 250.3 m2, less than the 14-lane map's 252.7 m2.

Removed the 10 non_driveable_obstacle boxes from warehouse_v2. With lanes derived from the collision scene they were redundant and contradictory: they cut 19.66 m2 of verified-clear floor out of the declared lanes while protecting 0 m2 of actual obstacle. Other worlds keep their own declarations; shipout follows via the YAML anchor.

change_1_camera_C_pitch.why: The blind cells under camera C are 2.3-2.5 m from the mount at 61-83 deg depression, inside its 8.6-67.4 deg band only at the far edge. Tilting down brings the near field into frame.
change_1_camera_C_pitch.why_44: Swept 38-80 deg. Net blind-cell change peaks at +20 cells around 44-44.5 deg and collapses past 45 deg, because camera C has a FIXED 58.7 deg vertical FOV: every degree down lifts the far edge off aisles no other camera holds (-402 cells at 80 deg). 44 deg recovers ~19-20 cells with ZERO new blind ground.
change_1_camera_C_pitch.unverified: This is FRUSTUM GEOMETRY ONLY. It shows the cells land in frame; it does NOT show q rises above 0.10. q is a fitted GP over commissioned detection outcomes, and at ~2 m the robot is steeply foreshortened near the image edge. Only re-commissioning q for camera C settles it.

change_2_Cm_barrel_destack.what: The four Cm drum stacks are reduced to a SINGLE tier. 30 visual drum links (tiers 1 and 2) removed; the four obs_Cm_p* collision prisms capped at 0.88 m. Cs and Cn stacks are UNTOUCHED.
change_2_Cm_barrel_destack.why_0_88: Drum tiers end at 0.88 / 1.76 / 2.64 m. Swept the cap height: 49 barrel-caused cells stay blind at 1.80 m, 5 at 1.06 m, and 0 at or below 1.00 m. 0.88 m is one tier and sits 0.12 m under that threshold.
change_2_Cm_barrel_destack.only_Cm_matters: Capping Cm alone is identical to capping all of section C at every height tested, and identical to deleting the stacks outright.
change_2_Cm_barrel_destack.verified: Re-measured against the edited world: 0 of the previously blind driveable cells remain occluded by any occluder (was 49).

CONSEQUENCE_FOR_EVIDENCE.detail: Both changes alter the world AFTER 22130 views were captured against the previous hash. The existing capture, the frozen-detector inference, the commissioned q GP and every R model describe the OLD world. They are not valid for this one.
CONSEQUENCE_FOR_EVIDENCE.recapture_lower_bound: Moving camera C invalidates all 4426 of its rows (20% of the dataset). The Cm de-stack additionally changes any view whose frustum contains those stacks, which is a superset of the 5296 rows (23.9%) measured for the whole C block and has NOT been measured for Cm alone.
CONSEQUENCE_FOR_EVIDENCE.blind_map_is_now_stale: experiments/warehouse_v2_sketches/blind_regions_map.json and .png were computed from the OLD world and the OLD q field. Regenerate only after q is re-commissioned; the geometry half would otherwise disagree with the availability half.
